name: life-ledger
description: Life Ledger - Track your life. Understand your habits. Build your future.

scripts.backend:gui: cd backend && CP="target/classes:"$(find ~/.m2/repository -name "*.jar" | tr '\n' ':') && java -cp "$CP" com.lifledger.gui.LifeLedgerGUI
scripts.backend:test: cd backend && CP="target/classes:"$(find ~/.m2/repository -name "*.jar" | tr '\n' ':') && java -cp "$CP" com.lifledger.test.LifeLedgerTestRunner
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
